# Delete Registry Key.vi

![Delete Registry Key.vi function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/connectivity/REG-06.svg)

[Connectivity functions](../index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Deletes the named child registry key in the selected registry view while forwarding the parent key reference.

Contract status: **partial**. The connector below describes Studio authoring; execution availability is stated separately.
